# Draft:Cold War in Africa

| caption           =
| combatant1        = Western Bloc states and affilated states:
| combatant2        = Eastern Bloc states and affilated states:
| combatant3        = Non-Aligned states:
}}
The Cold War in Africa refers to two things, one for the geopoliticical rivalry between the Western Bloc and Eastern Bloc, but also the non-aligned  countries and political rivalry between various states in Africa at the time of the Cold War.
